name: Cranberry Lake Nature Camp
description_short: County run nature day camp at Cranberry Lake Preserve, a 200 acre preserve in North White Plains, for kids entering grades 1 to 9. Younger groups (grades 1 to 3 and 4 to 6) come by the week; grades 7 to 9 take two week sessions with an optional overnight campout.

sessions.name: Exploring Campers session 1 (grades 7 to 9, two weeks)
Exploring Campers session 2 (grades 7 to 9, two weeks)

notes: Weekly rate for grades 1 to 6: $375 for Westchester County residents, $425 for non-residents. Grades 7 to 9 (Exploring Campers): $750 per two week session for residents and non-residents alike, optional overnight campout included. Hours 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Campers may attend at most three weeks.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. County nature camps page, 2026 season: registration for county residents opened first, non-residents from March 2026. Camp runs 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. in one and two week sessions, Monday July 6 through Friday August 14; campers may attend three weeks at most. Ages are derived from grades (entering grades 1 to 9), not stated. Weekly price is the non-resident rate; county residents pay less (see notes). Cranberry Lake groups: Happy Campers (grades 1 to 3) and Creative Campers (grades 4 to 6), six one week sessions July 6 to August 14, $375 resident, $425 non-resident; Exploring Campers (grades 7 to 9) two two week sessions, July 13 to 24 and July 27 to August 7, $750 for all.
Researched by Claude from this page. Cranberry Lake Preserve page: directions give 1609 Old Orchard Street, North White Plains, NY 10604. North White Plains is a hamlet in the town of North Castle.
